name: Dead Cave [Alpha]
desc:
You enter cave seeking diamonds and glory. But the cave holds more than treasure. Monsters lurk, and the deeper you dig, the darker it gets.

[New Update] SCP Update 💀

- New Item Drop: SCP-096's mouth can now drop from SCP-096.
- Other SCPs are coming soon...
